svg.title: One dot per command, placed at the danger score Jev gave it, hostile commands above ordinary ones
svg.text: Hostile commands pile up at the top. Ordinary work never reaches the block line.
One dot per command, at the score Jev gave it. Dots stack where scores repeat, so a tall column is a count.
The dashed lines are the thresholds: Jev asks you first from 0.35, and blocks from 0.80.
21 further attacks never got a score, because a local rule stopped them before Jev was called.
written to get past a classifier
real work that merely looks alarming

svg.text: danger score Jev gave the command
No ordinary command got past 0.75, so none of them would be blocked. The two lanes overlap only in the ask band, which is what the ask band is for.
